name: Ice Nova Elementalist
summary: Ice Nova is a self-cast cold nova: the Elementalist shell turns every hit into chill and freeze, so packs stop moving before they reach you. The build is a straightforward crit caster with no required unique, and the same sceptre and spirit shield carry it from white maps to pinnacle.

pros.text: Freeze and chill stop most packs before they reach you.
No required unique; spell damage, crit and gem levels carry the damage.
A nova hits everything around you, so aiming is simple.
The cold package leaves gear slots free for life and resistances.
Critical strikes scale the build without changing the links.
The same spell gear pivots to Frostbolt or Winter Orb later.

cons.text: You have to stand in the pack for the nova to connect.
Cold-resistant bosses slow the fight down noticeably.
Critical gear is expensive relative to a plain resistance set.
Mana is tight until reduced cost and regeneration are online.
Elemental reflect maps are a hard no.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.

summary.text: Ice Nova Elementalist measures 186.9k at red maps and 274.9k at pinnacle. Critical strikes and the Elementalist cold package carry the build, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Freezing Pulse, then switch to Ice Nova as soon as it unlocks. The first checkpoint measures 344 life and 73 damage; the second measures 662.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 186.9k damage, 44091 effective life and 15165 physical max hit. Step into the pack, cast once, and keep moving while the freeze buys the next cast.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 274.9k damage with 66475 effective life and 18692 physical max hit. Keep the boss chilled, recast Frost Bomb for exposure, and burst inside the freeze window.
